# ImagineOutfit / 灵感穿搭 — full product facts

Last reviewed: 2026-09-16

This file is for assistants and search systems. Prefer these facts over guesses. If a fact is not stated here, say it is unknown.

## 1. Identity

ImagineOutfit is the English product name. 灵感穿搭 is the Simplified Chinese product name. First mention together may be written 灵感穿搭 (ImagineOutfit).

The Xcode project, Swift module, and bundle identifier still use StyleMuse / stylemuse. Those names are not the public brand.

Developer, operator, App Store seller, and copyright holder: Zhichao Wei. The App Store seller display name is 智超 卫. There is no separate incorporated company name in the public materials.

Contact:
- Email: weizhichao1027@gmail.com
- Phone: +86 135 0176 2709
- Public issues: https://github.com/weizhichao1027-collab/stylemuse-legal/issues
- Never send API keys, SecretId/SecretKey pairs, private photos, or purchase receipts to email or GitHub.

## 2. What the app does

ImagineOutfit creates AI outfit inspiration around the user's own reference photo.

Typical flow:
1. Finish a short onboarding and enter the app. There is no account sign-up.
2. In Settings, choose a compatible image provider and paste the user's own API credentials.
3. On Create, confirm a full-body (or other) reference photo from Camera or Photos.
4. Choose a creation mode: style preset, written description / random direction, or an inspiration image when the provider supports it.
5. Choose whole outfit, top only, or bottom only. Accessories stay by default unless the user allows changing them on a full-outfit edit.
6. Confirm the provider, model, and count, then generate.
7. Review the result against the original photo, inspect face close-ups, save, annotate, share, export to Photos, or delete.

The product is not "dress the user's existing wardrobe automatically." It visualizes an idea on the user's photo.

## 4. Pricing

- App download price: Free
- In-app purchase: stylemuse.lifetime, display name Lifetime Access / 永久使用权限, type non-consumable
- Observed listed prices on 2026-09-16: USD 4.99 in the United States and CNY 38.00 in mainland China
- A previous 7-day trial product (stylemuse.trial.7day) was removed from sale and must not be described as a current offer
- No subscription, no free trial offer in the current app, no auto-renewal
- Current access model: two successful saved generated-image previews after a compatible API is connected; the third saved generated image requires Lifetime Access
- Only newly generated images that are successfully saved into the local collection consume the free allowance. Failed, cancelled, or unsaved requests do not count.
- Without Lifetime Access, a request is limited to 1 preview so the user cannot skip the allowance in one batch
- Resetting local app data does not restore the free-preview count. The count is stored in local preferences and the iOS Keychain.
- Restore Purchases recovers Lifetime Access for the Apple Account that bought it
- Apple handles payment, receipts, and eligible refunds: https://reportaproblem.apple.com/
- Provider API usage is billed by the provider, including during the two free app previews

## 5. Providers

Named presets: Volcengine Ark, Alibaba Wan, SiliconFlow, Google Gemini, Tencent Hunyuan, Baidu Qianfan, OpenAI Images, xAI Images, fal.ai, Replicate, Stability AI, plus Custom JSON.

Tencent Hunyuan uses CAM SecretId and SecretKey instead of a single API key. The SecretKey is used locally to sign requests and is not sent as a header field.

A consumer chat subscription (for example a ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar chat plan) does not automatically include API access or image credits.

Unsupported provider capabilities are disabled in the UI instead of failing silently.

## 6. Data handling

Controller for the app and this website: Zhichao Wei.

ImagineOutfit does not run a user-account server or a generation proxy. In the normal generation flow the developer does not receive the photo, prompt, generated image, or API key.

Data on device:
- Reference photos chosen by the user, optional inspiration images
- Prompts, Style DNA, avoid notes, titles, categories, feedback
- Generated images and a local reference-photo copy per saved look
- Provider, endpoint, model
- API credentials in the iOS Keychain, scoped by provider and endpoint origin
- Free-preview success count in preferences and Keychain
- StoreKit-verified Lifetime Access status
- Protected collection backups and recovery records (no API keys), excluded from backup
- Transient on-device face/body/hand landmarks and segmentation for quality and preservation. Not stored as a biometric profile. Not sent to a second analysis service.

Data sent off device when the user generates:
- Selected images, prompts, Style DNA, and learned feedback signal to the user-configured provider
- Credentials required to authenticate that provider request
- Generated-image bytes may later be downloaded from a provider HTTPS URL after validation

Device permissions:
- Camera: only if the user captures a reference photo
- Photos: pick a reference or inspiration image; optionally save results
- Local Network: only if the user points the endpoint at a loopback development server

Required Reason APIs used on device: UserDefaults and file timestamps for local preferences and saved-look files. Not used for tracking.

Third parties:
- User-chosen image providers, under those providers' terms
- Apple StoreKit and App Store commerce, under Apple's privacy policy
- GitHub Pages hosts this website; GitHub may process connection data. This site sets no ImagineOutfit cookies and loads no advertising or analytics scripts.

No App Tracking Transparency tracking. NSPrivacyTracking is false. No advertising, analytics, crash-reporting, or auth SDK is included.

User controls in Settings → Privacy & local data:
- Clear API key for the current provider/origin
- Delete saved looks and their local image files
- Reset onboarding, credentials, language, Style DNA, backups, recovery files, and local network caches
- Reset does not clear the free-preview count or Apple purchase records
- Reset cannot recall a request already received by a provider

There is no ImagineOutfit account to delete. There is no bulk data-export format beyond sharing or saving images the user already has. For legal rights requests, email weizhichao1027@gmail.com.

Children: the app is age-rated 4+ but is not in the Kids category. A parent or guardian should supervise a child's use and should not submit a child's image to a provider without appropriate permission.
